description: Runs the fixandflip.loans calculator on a deal: profit, cash you put in, return on cash (and simple annualized), profit as % of ARV, the hard-money loan with interest, points and fees, holding and selling costs, the 70% rule maximum price and whether the deal meets it, and the breakeven sale price. Optionally prices the loan at a listed lender's advertised starting rate.

arv.description: After-repair value (expected sale price) in dollars, e.g. 340000.

arv_cap_pct.description: Lender's maximum loan as % of ARV. Default 75.

buy_closing_costs.description: Buyer closing costs in dollars. Default 4000.

holding_costs_monthly.description: Taxes, insurance and utilities per month in dollars. Default 900.

interest_on.description: drawn (default): interest only on money drawn, rehab draws spread evenly; full_loan: interest on the whole loan from day one ("Dutch").

lender.description: Optional lender name (e.g. "Kiavi"): use its advertised fix-and-flip starting rate instead of rate_pct. Do not give both.

lender_fees.description: Underwriting, document and processing fees in dollars. Default 1995.

ltc_pct.description: Share of the purchase price the lender advances, %. Default 90.

months.description: Months from purchase to sale. Default 6.

points_pct.description: Origination points, % of the loan. Default 2.

rate_pct.description: Annual interest rate, %, from your own term sheet. Default 10.5 (the calculator's example, not a market rate).

rehab_funded_pct.description: Share of the rehab the lender funds in draws, %. Default 100.

seller_closing_pct.description: Seller closing costs and transfer tax as % of the sale price. Default 1.5.

selling_commission_pct.description: Agent commissions as % of the sale price. Default 5.

name: calculate_flip_profit
title: Fix-and-flip profit calculator
